PlayerListView

class PlayerListView(parent=None, player_edit_view_factory=None)[source]

Bases: QDialog, Ui_PlayerListView, WindowConfig

Dialog that lists and manages the players.

Shows a searchable table (ID and name) and a details panel. The widgets come from Ui_PlayerListView; all actions are handled by PlayerListController, which calls the methods below to update the window.

Parameters:
parentQDialog | None, optional

Parent widget. Default is None.

player_edit_view_factoryCallable | None, optional

Creates the edit dialog: factory(parent, player) returns the edit view. Default is None.

Attributes:
msgMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

controllerPlayerListController

Controller of the window.

Methods

populate_table(players)

Fill the table.

clear_details()

Clear the details panel.

display_details(player)

Show the details of a player.

get_selected_id()

Return the ID of the selected row.

select_row_by_id(player_id)

Select the row of an ID.

Notes

The window is fixed at 10% narrower and 5% shorter than the parent. Closing it asks for confirmation (translated with self.tr()).

Methods

populate_table(players)[source]

Fill the table with ID and name of each player.

Parameters:
playerslist[Player]

The players to show.

Notes

Table signals are blocked while filling, so no selection change is reported.

clear_details()[source]

Clear all fields of the details panel.

display_details(player)[source]

Show the details of a player.

Parameters:
playerPlayer | None

The player; None clears the panel.

Notes

The birth date is formatted with QtDateFormat.format_python_date and an empty observation shows a dash.

get_selected_id()[source]

Return the ID of the selected player.

Returns:
int | None

ID read from the first column, or None when nothing is selected or the text is not a number.

select_row_by_id(player_id)[source]

Select the row of a player ID and show it.

Parameters:
player_idint

ID to select; values of 0 or less are ignored.

Notes

Signals are blocked while selecting, and controller.on_table_selection is called afterwards.
